thread:
anna (BrightLedger): Hi @joan — after today's deploy our search results suddenly dropped citations for invoice queries. Previously top result included doc id inv-8a3f, now returns generic text with no citation link. Example query: "last invoice for Acct 42"; expected doc IDs: [inv-8a3f, inv-9b2c], got none. Severity: blocking for users.
joan (CS): Thanks Anna — opening an escalation. Can you paste a request id or the last few queries? tagging @vikram @mason to triage.
triage-bot: Deploy event: rollout-id=deploy-2026-03-17-11:04, models deployed: retriever-v2.1, reranker: reranker-v3.1, affected-tenants: BrightLedger (partial).
anna (BrightLedger): sample req_id: rq_20260317_112233. Repro curl below:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"query":"last invoice for Acct 42","top_k":5,"history":[]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieve
```
joan (CS): Reproduced with their req_id — I see top_k results returned but none get citation metadata. Capturing logs and pushing to the thread.
vikram (ML Eng): Looking now. Quick check: model registry shows reranker-lite-1 was promoted for this pool due to the gpu-optimizations autoswap flag. reranker-lite skews anchor scores down on longer docs, which can mask citations.
mason (Platform): Who flipped the autoswap? I can see node memory pressure during the retriever rollout at 11:03 triggered fallback. autoswap fallback picked lighter reranker variant to reduce memory.
vikram (ML Eng): Hypothesis: autoswap -> reranker-lite caused citation score distribution to shift left, dropping our citation threshold. Propose immediate rollback to reranker-gt-2.4 for BrightLedger tenant.
joan (CS): Customer is blocked. Can you patch tenant-level routing now?
mason (Platform): Initiating controlled rollback: canary 10% -> monitor -> 100%. Starting now. ETA ~8m.
triage-bot: Job update: rollback-canary started at 1795560000, job-id=rb-1795560000.
anna (BrightLedger): Thanks — will validate once the canary finishes.
joan (CS): Anna, when you can, rerun the same query and paste the top result snippet.
anna (BrightLedger): Ran it just now: top result is inv-8a3f with citation URL and excerpt present. Results look like expected — much better :relieved:.
vikram (ML Eng): Great, can keep reranker-gt pinned for BrightLedger. Next steps: run full eval set for reranker variants to quantify citation recall delta, and add a guard in autoswap to avoid swapping to "lite" variants without ML approval.
mason (Platform): Filed internal ticket INF-4213 for policy guardrails and node pool memory cushioning. Also adding deploy metric to alert on citation-rate regressions so we catch this earlier.
joan (CS): Closing this escalation for now, tracking follow-ups. Anna — please reopen if anything else appears. :thumbsup:
anna (BrightLedger): Appreciate the rapid response team!
